name: Virgin Red Rewards

apr.notes: 19.74%, 23.74%, or 27.74% based on creditworthiness. Varies with Prime Rate. Penalty APR up to 37.74%. Minimum interest charge $2.00.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fee. Mastercard converts non-USD transactions.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated; three APR tiers suggest creditworthiness-based approval. Typically requires good to excellent credit.

base_rate.description: 1x Virgin Point per $1 on all other purchases

categories.label: Virgin Atlantic, Virgin Hotels, Virgin Voyages
Grocery stores, dining, select streaming, EV charging

rewards.redemption_notes: Virgin Points redeemable for travel (flights, hotels, cruises), movie tickets, experiences, and charitable causes through Virgin Red. Points do not expire. Requires Virgin Red membership account.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 60,000 Virgin Points when you spend $4,000 in the first 90 days. Additional 2,500 points for adding an authorized user (up to 10,000 total).

benefits.title: Personal Perks (Big Spend Bonus)
benefits.description: Spend $15,000/year for one Personal Perk (companion seat, cabin upgrade, free night, or bar tab credit). Spend $30,000 to select two.

benefits.title: Virgin Atlantic Flying Club Tier Points
benefits.description: Earn 25 Tier Points when you spend $2,500 in a month. Maximum 50 Tier Points per month.

benefits.title: Third Night Free at Virgin Hotels
benefits.description: Book two nights and get third night free at participating Virgin Hotels once per year.

benefits.title: Anniversary Points Boost
benefits.description: Earn 5,000 Virgin Points every year upon card renewal.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made abroad.

benefits.title: Virgin Points Don't Expire
benefits.description: Virgin Points do not expire while the rewards program account is open and in good standing.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Third night free at participating Virgin Hotels once per year; priority room upgrade available as a Personal Perk
other: Virgin Atlantic Flying Club Tier Points (25 per $2,500 spent, max 50/month)
Personal Perks at $15k/$30k spend (companion seat, cabin upgrade, free night, or bar tab)

notes: Issued by Synchrony Bank. Official product/benefits page is on synchrony.com (not virgin.com co-branded page). World Elite Mastercard.
